title: China Mail 1934-06-16
subject: 德臣西報
德臣西报
China Mail
description: MUSSOLINI AND HITLER REACH AGREEMENT AT VENICE PARLEYS. "HANDS OFF" AUSTRIA PLEDGED. BRITAIN TO RETALIATE ON MORATORIUM. Anglo-German Clearing Office Planned. AGEEMENT TO BE SOUGHT BEFORE DEFINITE ACTIO. DETAILS CONSIDRED. PURCHASE RISK. STEEL STRIKE POSTPONED. Plan Submitted To Mediation Board. ANSCHLUSS VIRTUALLY ABANDONED. GEDRMAN CONCESSION FOR RIGHTS AT GENEVA. CLOSER CONTACT ASSURED. DRAWN CLOSER TOGETHER. AUSTRALIANS HELD. Bakewell And Timms Bat Doggedly Bat Doggedly. MR. PETER GRANT WEDS. Married To London Girl. REGISTRY OFFICE CEREMONY. AMERICA LEAD IN WIGHTMAN CUP AT WIMRLEDON. British Doubles Success. VISITING PAIR LOSE TWO SET POINT ADVANTAGES. Peggy Scriven Outclassed. STERN DAVIS CUP. Italy And Czechoslovakia On Level Terms. SIR ROBERT CLIVE IN TOKYO. NARROW ESCAPE FOR CUBAN PRESIDENT. Bomb Kills Stenographer Sitting Behind Him. CARNERA WORTH 27,102. Max Baer Wins Crown And 9,034. HEAVYWEIGHT BOXING RECEIPTS. FINLAND ALONE PAYS. U.S. War Debt Ledgers Closed. CONSIDERABLE IMPROVEMENT ON WALL ST. Brighter Market Over Week-End SILVER EXTREMELY DULL. FORMER A.S.P. DIES IN MELBOURNE. Mr. J. Kerr Survived By Widow And Son. NEW MINISTER FOR PANAMA ND COSTA RICA. CONSIDERABLE IMPROVEMENT ON WALL ST. Brighter Market Over Week-End. SILVER EXTREMELY DULL. FORMER A.S.P. DIES IN MELBOURNE. Mr. J. Kerr Survived By Widow And Son. NEW MINISTER FOR PANAMA AND COSTA RICA. POLICE POSSE SCOUR STANLEY FOR SOLDIERS. Alleged Attack On Car Driver. THREE BORDERER PRIVATES REPORTED MISSING. Kuomintang Leaders In Nanking. Japanese Naval Maneuvers. Kuramoto In Shanghai. NEW YORK'S TELEPHONE OVERCHARGES. Subscriber's Victory In Court Suit. 18,000,000 RACKET ALLEGED. MARCUS SHOW CHANGE. "Broadway Merry-Go Round To-morrow. "FANTASIES OF 1934" TO FOLLOW. THREE MEN RAID A PRISON. Tow Convicts Released After Fight. KILLED HIMSELF IN REMORSE. Boy's Suicide After Slapping Girl. INDIAN "GURU" CLAIMED 300 YEARS-OF-AGE. Startling Statement By Yogi. STRANGE POWESRS DEMONSTRATED. VOLUNTEER PRZE DISTRIBUTION. Importance Of Infantry. Stressed By G. O. C. LARGE GATHERING AT DINNER. GAS EXPLOSION INQUIRY. Government Expert On Gasometer Condition. WASTED BY CORROSION. MAN WHO LIVED IN TUNNELS. 'Human Mole' Sentenced In Los Angeles. SHOP ROBBERIES REVEALED. CODE OF MOALS FOR THEACHERS. Puritanical Traditions Denounced. SHOULD SMOKE AND DRINK. EXCITING JOB IN EAST AFRICA. Animals Often Invade Power Station. PROBLEMS FOR ENGINEER. POLICEMAN TURNS TOREADOR. Thrills For Crowd In Madrid Street. UNIVERSITY MEN CATCH THIEF. Thrilling Chase In Early Hours. AUSTRALIANS HELD. BRITAIN TO RETALIATE ON MORATORIUM. MR. PETER GRANT WEDS. AMERICA LEAD IN WIGHTMAN CUP AT WIMBLEDON. POLICE POSSE SCOUR STANLEY FOR SOLDIERS. FIVE MURDERED ON FARM. Youth's Blood-Lust In Yugoslavia. FAMILY DIAPUTE TRAGEDY. HDOME WRECKED BY COOKERY CLASS. Husband Dislikes New Dishes. CHILDREN THROUGH THE AGE3S . Fascinating Exhibition IN London. PROCEEDS FOR CHARITY. STARVING WOMAN'S FORTUNE. Huge Hoard Found In Rubbish Heap. 20,000POUNDS IN SECURITIES. FILM QUOTA PROBLEM IN BRITAIN. LOST LIFEBOAT TURNS UP. Drifts 2,700 Miles In 13 Months. SENSATIONAL AXE ATTACK IN SHANGHAI. Man Brutally Murdered And Wife Seriously Injured. FIVE INJURED IN CAR SMASH. Lorry In Collision On Castle Peak Road. UNIONISTS RETAIN MONMOUTH. Labour Parson Beaten At By-Election. TREASURY BILLS. CARNERA WORTH 27,102. FAMILY QUARREL SEQUEL. Girl Attempts Suicide In Harbour. NATIONAL PROHIBITION IN AMERICA. New Proposal To Restrict Traffic. SEWING MACHINE FORTUNE. Mr. W. M. G. Singer Leaves 1,096,018Pounds. LONDON DROUGHT COMMITTEE. Preparation For Emergencies. ROOSEVELT GIVEN CHECK. Spending Powers Heavily Curtailed. MR. ARDON'S APPOINTMENT.
